crm_entity_payments.empty: No payments for this record yet: match statement lines on the dashboard or create a payment link.
crm_entity_payments.not_connected: Tochka Bank is not connected. Connect in the app to sync statements.
crm_entity_payments.bad_entity_id: Could not determine the CRM record ID.
crm_entity_payments.create_link_modes: Payment methods on the Tochka page
crm_entity_payments.create_link_modes_required: Select at least one payment method.
crm_entity_payments.create_link_modes_tochka_help: The Tochka checkout only shows methods enabled for your merchant. T-Pay and Dolyame must be connected separately in online banking (often 2–3 business days). Very small amounts may hide installments on Tochka/Dolyame side.
crm_entity_payments.create_link_modes_retailer_missing: This merchant has no T-Pay and/or Dolyame in Tochka data — request them under Services → Internet acquiring in online banking.
crm_entity_payments.create_link_low_amount_modes: Very small amounts may hide T-Pay or Dolyame on the checkout even if enabled — try a higher amount to verify.
crm_entity_payments.create_link_modes_dropped_hint: Not all methods were sent to Tochka; removed: {list}. The checkout will only show methods allowed for the merchant.
crm_entity_payments.create_link_merchant_hint: Merchant ID (if you have multiple outlets)
crm_entity_payments.create_link_acquiring_required_title: Connect internet acquiring in Tochka first
crm_entity_payments.create_link_acquiring_required_intro: Payment links (card, SBP) work only after internet acquiring is enabled in Tochka online banking. Bank statement sync and payment matching work without acquiring.
crm_entity_payments.create_link_acquiring_required_step1: Sign in to Tochka online banking with a user who can sign applications.
crm_entity_payments.create_link_acquiring_required_step3: Submit the connection request and wait until your merchant outlet is active (usually 2–5 business days).
crm_entity_payments.create_link_acquiring_required_step4: Return to Bitrix24, click Refresh on the payments tab, then Payment link again.
crm_entity_payments.create_link_acquiring_required_merchant: Leave Merchant ID empty if you have only one merchant outlet.
crm_entity_payments.create_link_acquiring_required_support: If you already applied, wait until status shows as connected in online banking. For multiple outlets, enter Merchant ID from your Tochka dashboard.
crm_entity_payments.create_link_purpose_hint: Insert CRM fields below or type your own text. The default line depends on the amount kind.
crm_entity_payments.create_link_purpose_pattern_deal_remaind: Additional payment under contract No. {no} of {date}
crm_entity_payments.create_link_purpose_pattern_lead_remaind: Additional payment for lead No. {no} of {date}
crm_entity_payments.settings_uf_hint: After a successful link payment, values are written to the deal/lead fields.
crm_entity_payments.consent_upgrade_required: To create payment links, you need to update Tochka account permissions. Click the button below and confirm access.
